selection_basis: Calculation-boundary, concentration and combustion remain sparse, but their source-ready propositions are either already covered or previously rejected as wording variants, shallow recall or excessive microkinetic detail. Wave 8 instead selects two source-ready material distinctions with high marginal value: a concrete incompatibility reaction under chemical change (4 verified against 30) and unrepresented cresol properties (22 verified against 50). No third range is permitted.

authoring_rule: Enumerate source-defined propositions before authoring, collision-check against all 294 canonical/source-verified questions and the full Wave 8 peer set, and stop without backfill when material distinctions are exhausted.
multi_source_rule: Each candidate binds to one registered source_id, source_version and reproducible pinpoint locator. Cross-source answer-defining comparisons are prohibited without an approved source-bundle contract.
